_comment: Ability -> canonical reminder text, used by --inject-reminder-text. Keys are matched case-insensitively in the card rules text; with the flag on, every card carrying a listed ability gets exactly this sentence (any printed variant of it is replaced, a missing one is added). A value may contain {cost}, which is replaced by the cost following the ability on the card (e.g. Ward {2}). Wording seeded from the most common official printed reminders in the Scryfall cache; edit freely. Also supports card-type-specific variants like "flying:wall" which will be used when the card has type "Wall", and card-specific variants like "trample:overrun" for cards with special reminder text.
flying: This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.
flying:wall: This creature can block creatures with flying.
vigilance: Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.
haste: This creature can attack as soon as it comes under your control.
first strike: This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.
double strike: This creature deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.
trample: This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player it's attacking.
trample:overrun: Each of those creatures can deal excess combat damage to the player it's attacking.
deathtouch: Any amount of damage this deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.
lifelink: Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.
reach: This creature can block creatures with flying.
hexproof: This creature can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.
menace: This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.
ward: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {cost}.
infect: This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.
regenerate:uthden troll: The next time this creature would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove it from combat, and heal all damage on it.
regenerate: The next time this creature would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove it from combat, and heal all damage on it.
